subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be denied `sessions.patch` access to all legacy ownerless session rows immediately after upgrade?
rationale: Failing closed prevents arbitrary plugin adoption, but it intentionally stops previously accepted plugin-runtime mutations of rows created before ownership metadata existed.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject ownerless legacy rows and provide explicit upgrade proof and operator guidance for managing them outside plugin runtime.

options.title: Add trusted migration
options.body: Create a doctor migration only for rows whose plugin ownership can be established without allowing arbitrary adoption.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless legacy rows and provide explicit upgrade proof and operator guidance for managing them outside plugin runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current projection and SQLite lifecycle boundary where the permanent authorization and upgrade policy must be implemented.
